data.title: Bitcoin slumps to near 5-mth low below $62k as AI rout batters risk appetite
data.description: Investing.com-- Bitcoin slumped to a near five-month low on Friday and was headed for a seventh straight week of losses as a debilitating rout in global artificial intelligence valuations left traders wary of any risky bets.
